Savings Goal Calculator

Find the exact monthly deposit you need to reach a savings goal by your deadline, with interest factored in.

–

Deposits are assumed at the end of each month, earning interest from the next month on.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your savings goal amount.
  2. Enter your current savings and expected annual rate.
  3. Set how many years you have to reach the goal.
  4. Read the required monthly deposit, total deposits and interest earned.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the monthly deposit calculated?

The required payment solves the future-value-of-an-annuity formula: PMT = (goal − current·(1+i)^n) · i / ((1+i)^n − 1), where i is the equivalent monthly rate.

What if my current savings already reach the goal?

Then the required deposit is zero — your current savings already cover the goal with interest to spare.

Is the interest rate guaranteed?

No — it assumes a constant rate and ignores inflation, taxes and fees. Treat it as a planning estimate.
